I recently did some shopping at Fazyo, Angamaly, and purchased a few dresses from there. However, I was quite disappointed with the behaviour of the female staff members.

While we were looking around the store, they kept watching us and following us wherever we went, which made us feel extremely uncomfortable. It felt as though we were being treated with suspicion, almost as if we were there to steal something.

I understand that staff need to be attentive, but customers should also be treated with basic respect and trust. Although I did purchase a few dresses that day, the experience left a very negative impression on me, and I have decided not to shop there again in the future.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and works on creating a more comfortable and welcoming environment for customers.

reviews.comment: Excellent service from the sales team, especially Ms. Ragi and Ms. Nikhila. They were friendly, professional, and very helpful throughout the purchase. The products are of excellent quality and available at great prices. Highly recommended!

Visited the store today, and I honestly had a great experience. I was actually in a rush, but the ambience was so calm and welcoming that it instantly made me feel relaxed.

I went in looking for formals and since they're usually pretty expensive at most brands, I wasn't expecting much. But the prices here genuinely surprised me. They had a really good collection, and the formals were much more affordable than I expected.

A big thanks to Joel M. Titto for helping me throughout my shopping. To be honest, when he first approached me, I thought he might be new. But within a few minutes, that thought completely changed. He understood exactly what I was looking for, patiently showed me every option that matched my requirements, and never made me feel rushed. He was friendly, easy to talk to, and genuinely interested in helping rather than just making a sale. i am very satisfied with his service. Customer service like that really makes a difference.

The staff at the billing counter were also very friendly and supportive, and it was nice to see everyone working together with a smile.

Overall, it was a really satisfying shopping experience. Great ambience, affordable prices, an excellent collection, and amazing customer service. I'll definitely be coming back and would happily recommend to my friends and family
